findings.title: get_monitor_environment_context copies config but returns the unmodified original
findings.body: In get_monitor_environment_context, a local `config = monitor_environment.monitor.config.copy()` is built and its `schedule_type` is replaced with the human-readable display value (lines 160-162), but the returned dict uses `monitor_environment.monitor.config` (line 168) instead of the local `config`. The intent of mapping schedule_type to a display string is silently dropped, so the monitor context published in the issue event always contains the raw schedule type. This was carried over from mark_failed.py, but since the code is being reorganized into its own module it should be fixed: return `"config": config`.

findings.title: mark_failed_threshold and create_issue_platform_occurrence removed without aliases or test updates shown
findings.body: The refactor deletes `mark_failed_threshold` and `create_issue_platform_occurrence` from sentry.monitors.logic.mark_failed and replaces them with `try_incident_threshold` in sentry.monitors.logic.incidents and `create_incident_occurrence` in sentry.monitors.logic.incident_occurrence. Any code (tasks, scripts, tests, or external consumers) importing these public module-level functions from `sentry.monitors.logic.mark_failed` will now fail with ImportError. The PR shows no changes to callers or tests, so if tests or other modules referenced the old names, they were not updated in this diff; verify no remaining references exist before merging.

findings.title: Docstring typos: "humam readible" and stale examples
findings.body: The docstring for get_failure_reason says "Builds a humam readible string" (should be "human readable"), and its example outputs do not match the actual format: the function returns e.g. "A missed check-in was detected" for the singular case and "N status check-ins detected" for the plural, not the free-form examples listed ("3 missed check-ins detected", "A failed check-in was detected"). Misleading docs in a freshly extracted module should be corrected.
